paragraphs: PowerTime is scheduling and workforce management software built for public safety agencies. The software covers employee schedules, overtime, leave requests, and time tracking from one secure cloud platform. The stated audience is law enforcement agencies, corrections, fire departments, EMS organizations, emergency communications centers, and other public safety employers.

Overtime lists are built from agency rules, union agreements, FLSA requirements, employee availability, consecutive hours worked, and seniority. Supervisors review employee time, leave requests, overtime, and exceptions from a centralized dashboard. After time is approved, the platform exports payroll-ready data and reporting on schedules, overtime, leave balances, staffing, and labor costs.

Employees view schedules, request time off, swap shifts, clock in and out, and sign up for available overtime using the web or mobile app. Schedule building covers recurring patrol rotations, fire schedules, dispatcher shifts, and correctional staffing plans under configurable scheduling rules. The page positions the product against physical master boards, manual shift grids, and generic commercial calendars used inside first responder teams.

quote.text: PowerTime is scheduling and workforce management software built specifically for public safety agencies.
